# D19 — Agent contract: AGENTS.md generated by Init

`kb.Init` creates `AGENTS.md` with soft guidance on style, naming, workflow, when to lint. Added to `reservedNames` in `okf` (does not appear in `WalkConcepts`).

> **Superseded by D62**: `kb.Init` no longer generates `AGENTS.md`. The filename remains in
> `reservedNames`/`IsReserved` (backward compatibility: KBs that still have it from a previous
> `Init` keep working, the file is simply ignored by the server).
